name: cheat-persona
title_zh: 复盘数据里长出来的受众画像，写稿前先看它
tagline_zh: 别再猜观众是谁。从你的复盘评论里提炼实绩信号，生成 audience.md。选题写稿前扫一眼，落笔就对准了人。
tagline_en: Stop guessing who's watching. Mine your review comments for real signals, generate audience.md, and aim every.
desc_en: 从复盘评论数据派生 / 刷新账号的受众画像，写入 audience.md。这是和 rubric 平行的第二个派生物——rubric 答"怎么打分"，persona 答"谁在看"。cheat-seed 选题 / 写稿时读它。**audience.md 含实绩信号，cheat-score-blind 硬禁读**。触发词："构造受众画像"/"更新 persona"/"我的观众是谁"/"build persona"/"刷新受众画像"/"看看我的受众画像"。
why_zh: 与 rubric 平行，一个管打分标准，一个管谁在看。基于真实复盘数据而非拍脑袋。
why_en: Parallel to rubric—one scores, one knows the viewer. Built from real review data, not guesses, with a hard isolation so.
limit_zh: 只吃复盘评论数据，没跑过复盘流程或评论为空则产出空壳。只生成 audience.md，不负责选题和写稿。
limit_en: Only ingests review comments; empty or no review run yields a hollow file. Outputs audience.md only, no drafting. cheat-score-blind must not read it.
title_en: Audience persona grown from review data, read before writing
